import sys

def process_token(s):
    if not s:
        return ""
    out = s[0]
    i = 1
    at_replaced = False
    while i < len(s):
        next_at = s.find("at", i)
        next_dot = s.find("dot", i)
        if not at_replaced and next_at != -1 and (next_dot == -1 or next_at < next_dot):
            out += s[i:next_at] + '@'
            at_replaced = True
            i = next_at + 2
        elif next_dot != -1 and (next_at == -1 or next_dot < next_at or at_replaced):
            out += s[i:next_dot] + '.'
            i = next_dot + 3
        else:
            out += s[i:]
            break
    return out

def main():
    tokens = sys.stdin.read().split()
    for token in tokens:
        print(process_token(token))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
